authMarketingHeroTitle:
Application season is complex.
Your workspace shouldn’t be.
authMarketingHeroBody: Programs, professors, materials, email, deadlines, and decisions — one clear path.
authMarketingStoryBody: Each application keeps its own dossier, so progress, materials, and conversations always move together.
authMarketingTrackBody: Switch applications on the left, work in the dossier, and keep deadlines and progress visible in the inspector.
authMarketingDeadlineBody: Application, task, material, and funding dates come together in one timeline.
authMarketingOrganizeBody: Material versions, professor email, and application tasks stay in place — and connected.
authMarketingAccessBody: Sign in to continue, or create an account and add your first application.
